Title: Azure SignalR Service is now available

Body.Content:
Azure SignalR Service is now available. Azure SignalR Service is a fully managed service that allows developers to focus on building real-time web experiences without worrying about hosting, scalability, load balancing, or authentication. Through tight integration with the .NET SignalR library and Visual Studio family, the service makes it easier to deliver real-time experiences such as chat, instant broadcasting, and live dashboards.
